history.text: Greetings, the name I use at work is Tavelune.
Greetings!
Quick check: how should you address me?
Most people use Nivorra for me. That's also my stage name.
Pleased to meet you.
What stage name did I just mention?
While you may know my cousin Weris, you can refer to me as Elodrin.
Thanks for introducing yourself.
Give the name to use for me alone.
Here's the handover: Meros gets the striped parcel and Dalen gets the spotted parcel. Whose parcel is spotted?
Here's the handover: Meros gets the striped parcel and Dalen gets the spotted parcel. Whose parcel is spotted?
Dalen
Who receives the striped parcel then?
The silver badge belongs to Orive; the brass one belongs to Navas. Who wears brass?
I formerly called the project Lomuri. I'm calling it Pasuri now. What should go on the current folder?
The dispatch office initially recorded Turona.
Understood.
An amended slip replaces that entry with Ferona. Copy the one that still applies.
The number pencilled on the dial was 28.
Understood.
A fresh reading shows 73. Which reading supersedes the pencil mark?
We visit Solmar, Vallen, and Isero, in that order. Which is the final visit?
I placed Neril at the head of the line, then Osena and Melka. Who is at its head?
The three stamps, in order, say Ambrin, Orset, and Farlun. Which one lies in the middle?
If we get a solid mark, the route card says Arelis. For a hollow mark it says Vennor. Our mark is hollow. Read the route name.
Guests with a pearl ticket meet Orova. Guests with a copper ticket meet Nelys. My ticket is pearl. Which person do I meet?
A weighing slip lists scale 18 and mass 64. Read the mass only.
Yesterday's setting was 9.5. Today's setting is 4.2. Give today's value.
I have the two terms Rusca and Menora. Put a square bracket on either side of Rusca.
Lowercase the code DORFIN.
The dispatch note is unsigned. Tell me who wrote it.
Our delivery slip gives the sender as Kirova. Can you determine the package weight?
Could you show me the right one?

target: Which options are you choosing between?

history.text: Morning! I wanted to say hello.
Could you suggest a friendly opening for a rehearsal invitation?

target: I'd love for you to join our rehearsal.

history.text: Why put measurements on a drawing?

target: They tell the reader how large the parts should be.

history.text: The label once showed 36. It now shows 81. Which was on it before the change?
The word before the slash is Vesaro; the second word is Tiluna. Which comes after the slash?
If I carry the heavy basket, Qorim holds the light basket. I'm carrying the heavy one. Who has the light one?
As host I wear a jade ribbon; the guest wears ochre. What color marks the guest?
The courier is named Tinerra. No delivery time is listed. When did the delivery happen?
Can you turn 'Leran chose a violet scarf' into the future tense?

target: Leran will choose a violet scarf.
